page.notes: Two marginal notes at left/right edges were read as the right margin; the Greek fragment in the Explicatio line, which reads "vobis" followed by a small Greek phrase, is not legible and is marked as illegible. The mark "⌣" before "Apostolos" is a printed sign of uncertain meaning and was copied as printed. Several superscript star and letter marks in the Explicatio paragraph are attached to the notes by position; their exact pairing is uncertain. Small type at the very bottom of the text ends with a half-word (Vicariatus / quamuis), which runs over to the next page.
